goal_and_scope: Determine whether the supplied fixed-contact cubic compensation and the N800/N803 averaged-Hessian structure imply a uniform near-contact Jensen inequality over every affine background in the full nine-coefficient left-SO(2)-invariant quartic cone.

evidence_refs.status: internal derivation; conditional on reduced-Schur comparability
exact finite Fourier algebra for two compatible G families
exact rational leading coefficients for one resonant family
rational scaling check of the supplied exact localized profile

inherited_inputs: For fixed contact (A,R), |R|=1, the incoming theorem bounds |b[A]| by K sqrt(h) ||X||_4 ||Y||_4 and |H[A,R]| by K sqrt(h) ||Y||_2, with constants depending on F,A,R.
N800 nullspace closure gives H positive semidefinite and b in ran H for compatible balanced gradients; singular faces have a global Jensen theorem.
N803 gives rank-three D^2F(R) at non-polyconvex rank-one contacts and a positive transverse block on A-perp; its two-contact modulus has no acquired uniform power law.
acquired_inputs: A uniform all-background pure-line Jensen margin F(R)||s||_4^4/3.
An exact completion identity around alpha R, alpha=E(s^3)/(3E(s^2)), and a conditional full-background theorem assuming h*=0 or h*>=theta h.
Exact compatible examples refuting the shortcut h*>=theta h, including a full-rank averaged Hessian example, plus a resonant anisotropic family with positive optimized gap.

source.object_and_domain: Homogeneous quartics in the full nine-coefficient left-SO(2)-invariant cone, rank-one-convex, with a fixed acoustic contact (A,R).
source.input_quantifier: Every periodic or zero-boundary W1,4 gradient X=sR+Y with EX=0 and small relative L2 and L4 transverse norms.
source.representation_and_access: The gradient is acquired as a compatible field; determinant balance and curl compatibility are exact. No law replacement is allowed.
source.norms_and_losses: The fixed-contact estimates use h=H[A,A], ||X||_4, ||Y||_4 and ||Y||_2. K depends on F,A,R; no uniformity over integrands or contacts is supplied.
source.cost_and_precision: Infinite-dimensional W1,4 input; no finite representation or computational cost guarantee.

destination.object_and_domain: The optimized variational gap Delta_F(X)=inf_B E[F(B+X)-F(B)] over all B in R^(2x2).
destination.output_quantifier: For each fixed F/contact, all sufficiently near-contact compatible gradients and every affine background, without a bound on the optimizer.
destination.required_norms: The desired domain is ||Y||_2<=delta||s||_2 and ||Y||_4<=delta||s||_4, with arbitrary Fourier bandwidth, resonances and concentration.
destination.missing_condition: The conditional theorem also assumes h*=h-k^T D^-1 k is zero or bounded below by theta h. The inherited theorem does not supply this.
destination.cost_and_precision: Purely variational; no implementation or finite-certificate cost is claimed.

representation_and_assumptions: The exact transfer is established only on the reduced-Schur-comparable subclass. Full transfer requires controlling the moving scalar Schur residual after eliminating A-perp, while preserving gradient compatibility and allowing escaping backgrounds.
exact_missing_lemma: For r=b-H(alpha R), alpha=E(s^3)/(3E(s^2)), prove |r[A]-k^T D^-1 r_W|^2 <= C delta^2 ||s||_4^4 h* uniformly for compatible near-contact gradients, including h*=0 by range closure. Equivalently, prove the reduced Schur loss is O(delta^2 ||s||_4^4) without assuming h* comparable to h.
conditional_established_interface: If h*=0 or h*>=theta h for a fixed theta>0, the exact Schur formula, the pure-line margin, rank-three transverse coercivity and the two supplied compensation estimates imply Delta_F(X)>0 for sufficiently small delta. See REPORT.md lines 40-110.

refuted_shortcut.transfer: Rank D^2F(R)>=3 and the contact estimates imply h*>=theta h uniformly near the contact line.
refuted_shortcut.counterexample: For G, X=(e12+epsilon e22)cos y+epsilon^2 e11 cos x is a compatible rank-two covariance field with H positive definite, h~epsilon^2 and h*~(9/4)epsilon^4, so h*/h->0. Its all-background gap remains positive; this refutes only the shortcut, not Jensen positivity.

comparator: The pure rank-one-line Jensen margin is F(R)||s||_4^4/3 for every background. N800 exact singular-face Jensen and N803 two-contact rigidity are the strongest inherited controls, but neither bounds the positive-definite reduced Schur remainder.
falsifier_or_next_experiment: For the missing lemma, search an exact compatible Fourier or concentrating family with delta->0 and (beta_*^2/(h_*||s||_4^4))/delta^2 unbounded. A negative Delta_F(X) in this near-contact regime would directly falsify the desired theorem. The 10-family rational scan in scan_resonant_contacts.json is only a bounded control.
